# GeoShield Saudi

Official website for GeoShield branches in Al Ahsa (Al Hofuf) and Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia.

Website: https://aveni-cmd.github.io/geoshield/
Language: Arabic (RTL)
Primary market: Saudi Arabia
Affiliation: وكالة جيوشيلد لفرعي الأحساء والخفجي تابعة لمجموعة عواد الظفيري

## Main services

- Paint Protection Film (PPF)
- Thermal insulation: V-NANO, APEX, C2
- Nano ceramic coating
- Professional polishing
- Glass protection
- Undercar protection
- Interior wrapping/protection

## Branches

Both GeoShield branches are affiliated with مجموعة عواد الظفيري.

## Warranty and aftercare

- PPF: unlimited warranty according to warranty terms; covers manufacturing defects, bubbles, peeling, yellowing, and cracking.
- Thermal insulation: unlimited warranty according to warranty terms; covers manufacturing defects, bubbles, peeling, yellowing, and separation.
- Nano Ceramic 9H: 3 years for application and 5 years for layers.
- Do not wash for 7 days after PPF or ceramic installation.
- Do not open windows for 48 hours after thermal insulation installation.
- Avoid chemicals and rain for 4 hours.
- Free inspection within 4 weeks.
- Periodic maintenance every 6 months is required to maintain warranty coverage.
- Keep the invoice for maintenance and warranty service.

## Notes

- Package prices shown on the website exclude VAT.
- Booking requests are prepared in the website and then sent to the selected branch through WhatsApp.
- The agency statement used on the website is: وكالة جيوشيلد لفرعي الأحساء والخفجي تابعة لمجموعة عواد الظفيري
- For current prices and offers, use the visible website content as the primary source.
